cards.definition: To tell someone your name, or to present one person to another.
cards.example:
- Let me introduce myself: I am Paula, from the sales team.
Deixa eu me apresentar: sou a Paula, da equipe de vendas.
cards.note: Introduce myself = me apresentar. “Introdução” de texto = introduction.

cards.definition: A group of people who work together on the same tasks.
cards.example:
- I work on the marketing team with five other people.
Trabalho na equipe de marketing com outras cinco pessoas.
cards.note: On/in a team. Time de futebol também é team.

cards.definition: A part of a company that does one type of work.
cards.example:
- The finance department is on the second floor.
O departamento financeiro fica no segundo andar.

cards.definition: The person who is in charge of you at work.
cards.example:
- My boss is friendly, but she is very organized.
Minha chefe é simpática, mas é muito organizada.
cards.note: Informal e universal; a versão formal é manager.

cards.definition: A student or beginner who works to get experience, usually for a short time.
cards.example:
- The new intern starts on Monday morning.
O novo estagiário começa segunda de manhã.

cards.definition: Having the duty to take care of something.
cards.example:
- I am responsible for the social media posts.
Sou responsável pelos posts das redes sociais.
cards.note: Sempre com for: responsible FOR something.

cards.translation: o que você faz (da vida)? qual é sua profissão?
cards.definition: A question that asks about someone's job.
cards.example:
- — What do you do? — I am a designer.
— O que você faz? — Sou designer.
cards.note: NÃO é “o que você está fazendo agora” (isso é What are you doing?).

cards.definition: Used to say which company employs you.
cards.example:
- I work for a small tech company in Curitiba.
Trabalho para uma empresa pequena de tecnologia em Curitiba.
cards.note: Work for + empresa; work at + lugar; work as + profissão.

cards.definition: The room or building where you do your work.
cards.example:
- My office is small, but it has a big window.
Meu escritório é pequeno, mas tem uma janela grande.

cards.definition: A book with empty pages, used for writing notes.
cards.example:
- I write all the new English words in a notebook.
Anoto todas as palavras novas de inglês num caderno.
cards.note: O seu “notebook” (computador) em inglês é laptop!

questions.prompt: Let me _____ myself: I am Paula, from the sales team.
questions.explanation: “Introduce myself” — the reflexive stays in English.

questions.prompt: I work on the marketing _____ with five other people.
questions.explanation: “On the team” in the US, “in the team” in the UK.

questions.prompt: O departamento financeiro fica no segundo andar.
questions.answer: The finance department is on the second floor.|The finance department is on the 2nd floor.

questions.prompt: The person who is in charge of you at work is your…
questions.explanation: “Boss” is your manager; an “intern” is a beginner.

questions.prompt: The new _____ starts on Monday morning.
questions.explanation: An “intern” works to gain experience, usually while studying.

questions.prompt: Eu sou responsável pelos posts nas redes sociais.
questions.answer: I am responsible for the social media posts.|I'm responsible for the social media posts.

questions.prompt: You want to know someone's job. You ask:
questions.explanation: “What are you doing?” asks about this exact moment.

questions.prompt: _____ a small tech company in Curitiba.
questions.explanation: “Work for” a company, “work at” a place, “work in” an area.

questions.prompt: My _____ is small, but it has a big window.
questions.explanation: “Office” is the room or the building where you work.

questions.prompt: You write new English words on paper. You use a…
questions.explanation: In English a “notebook” is paper. The computer is a “laptop”.
